scenes.narration: You sat through the whole lecture. You even took notes. And by Friday, most of it was gone.
Meet Study Scribe AI. Record once, and turn it into everything you need to study.
Here is the whole idea. Drop in a lecture. The transcript appears. Then your notes, your flashcards, and a quiz. All from one recording.
Record live, upload a file, or paste a link. Study Scribe takes it from there.
Transcription starts on its own, in twenty-seven languages, so it works for the way you actually learn.
Every word is timestamped and labeled by speaker. Click any line, and you are back at that exact moment.
Clean study notes appear in seconds, organized around the ideas that matter.
Flashcards write themselves, and export straight to Quizlet, Anki, or Notion.
Let's try one. What does AI stand for? Take a second... Got it? Artificial intelligence. Flashcards make recall that easy.
Then study the way that sticks. Start with recognition, then graduate to written recall.
And when you are ready, test yourself with a practice exam.
Take a ten-question quiz with instant feedback.
Now a real question from that same lecture. Pick your answer. If you chose the third option, you are right. And you get instant feedback on every question.
Or read a structured study guide, built from your own lecture.
Stuck? Ask the AI tutor. It answers from what was actually said in your class.
Working, not studying? Turn meetings into summaries and follow-up emails, in the tone you choose.
Study Scribe is for students cramming before finals, professionals buried in meetings, and anyone learning in another language.
Whether it is a forty-second reading, a seven-minute class, or a one-minute lecture, it all lives in one library.
And your recordings stay yours. Export everything, or delete it all, anytime.
Getting started is simple. Request your invite. Add your first lecture. Then start studying.
From the first lecture to the final exam. Study Scribe AI. Record once, study smarter. Try it free today.
